question: Tell me top10 teams with the most wins across the league
sql:
SELECT team_short_name, 
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
       SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS wins
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t ON (m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id OR m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id)
GROUP BY team_short_name, t.team_api_id
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 10
